services.desc: Jump into the basket on one of our eight colorful balloons at the Great Balloon Race. 48” unless accompanied by a responsible companion. Minimum age to ride: 2 years old. Total riders per basket: 4. Maximum weight per basket: 660lbs. Additional safety information posted at the attraction. Hang on to your seats because these balloons rise and spin over 25 feet in the air! It’s up, up and away excitement! LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE Adventure City!
